brief:
Businessman Tariq al-Natshe was transferred to Ramallah hospital Thursday evening accompanied by Palestinian Authority security forces after suffering a health crisis while in detention, Shehab Wire reported. The transfer occurred following a deterioration in his condition inside PA prisons, though specifics of his medical situation remained unclear.

Al-Natshe's hospitalization marks a significant escalation in his case during custody. His detention and subsequent health emergency have drawn attention from monitors of conditions in Palestinian security facilities, who have raised concerns about detainee welfare in recent months.
